findings.summary: exports points at './src/index.ts'; bare `node` cannot resolve .ts (verified: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND). All current consumers (tsx/vitest) transpile so dev+tests are green, but production `node dist/main.js` will fail to load @medbridge/contracts.
findings.suggested_fix: Either (a) emit JS to dist/ (drop emitDeclarationOnly in packages/contracts/tsconfig.json) and set exports={'.':{import:'./dist/index.js',types:'./dist/index.d.ts'}}, or (b) bundle contracts into apps/api at build time and document the source-only contract.

findings.summary: No TypeScript project `references` to ../../packages/contracts though contracts is composite and apps/api imports from it; `tsc -b` works today only because the workspace symlink exposes contracts/dist/*.d.ts.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `"references": [{"path": "../../packages/contracts"}]` so apps/api's `tsc -b` rebuilds contracts on contracts source change and the composite graph is self-consistent.

findings.summary: Runtime dep @hono/node-server is not enumerated in ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3 allow-list (which lists hono, drizzle-orm, pg, zod, argon2, jose, pino). The Node adapter is necessary for Hono on Node but undocumented.
findings.suggested_fix: Add @hono/node-server to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3 as the Hono Node adapter, or capture in a tech-stack ADR.

findings.summary: On-disk content (`export * from './auth.js'`) differs from wave-2's empty barrel — re-exports added by wave-3 commit 97c93ef. Not a wave-2 defect; the wave-2 scaffold spec called for an empty barrel and that is what 0ba770d committed.
findings.suggested_fix: No action for wave-2; the auth re-export is covered by review-wave-3 findings. Informational pointer that the working-tree state reflects later waves.
